# Alcoa Turns Raw Potential into Real Progress

Building a Legacy of Excellence for Future Generations

## Inspired by our vision and guided by our values

### Creating Impact

Our vision is to build a legacy of excellence for future generations. We’ll realize this vision by
running the safest and most reliable operations in the industry while growing our people and shaping
the future. We're turning today's work into a stronger future - not just for Alcoa, but for the
industry and world we help build.

video

Please enable *targeting cookies* to watch videos. You can enable targeting cookies on our [Cookie
Policy page][60].

### Our Commitment

Every day, you’ll find us striving to protect the safety and health of our global workforce and our
environment. We actively engage with our stakeholders in the communities where we operate. We are
focused on not just today, but tomorrow as well - for the people and communities who come next.

### Our People

From purposeful career development and inclusive and diverse work teams, Alcoa employees turn raw
potential into real progress. Today, we continue to channel the determination that first launched an
industry. We’re leading with the same boldness that shaped our history - and setting a new standard
that others will look to for generations.

## Alcoa Worldview

### Alcoa Australia’s Environmental Symposium Shines Light on World-Leading Research

Alcoa Australia’s Environmental Symposium saw 150 people from 34 organisations converge at Murdoch
University for some meaningful conversation.

Read More

### Alcoa, Port of Trois Rivières Inaugurate New Port Facilities Dedicated to Unloading Raw
### Materials for Deschambault Smelter

Alcoa and the Trois Rivières Port Authority (TRPA) officially inaugurated today Alcoa’s new
facilities at Wharf 17, marking an important milestone in the long-standing collaboration between
the two organizations.

Read More

### Alcoa Publishes 2025 Sustainability Report

On World Environment Day, Alcoa released its 2025 Sustainability Report, outlining the Company’s
approach to environmental, social and governance (ESG) topics and the progress made throughout the
year across its global operations.

# We are a global material solutions company

We mine, process and sell industrial minerals at locations worldwide, focused primarily on silica,
clays, feldspathics and olivine. We are also leaders in glass recycling.

Scroll down

## Who we are

### 
### About Sibelco

Founded in 1872, we have grown into a multinational business with operations in 31 countries and an
extensive multi-mineral portfolio. We work across a broad range of industries, anticipating and
meeting our customers’ changing needs with innovative solutions that combine high-specification
materials and dedicated technical support.

Everything we do is guided by our purpose:* material solutions advancing life*. Our products help to
build homes, cities and vehicles; to support the supply of renewable energy, food and clean water;
to create technologies such as smartphone display screens, printed circuit boards and
semiconductors.

We do this within a robust sustainability framework, always balancing economic performance with
environmental stewardship and social responsibility.

# We are a global material solutions company

We mine, process and sell industrial minerals at locations worldwide, focused primarily on silica,
clays, feldspathics and olivine. We are also leaders in glass recycling.

Scroll down

## Who we are

### 
### About Sibelco

Founded in 1872, we have grown into a multinational business with operations in 31 countries and an
extensive multi-mineral portfolio. We work across a broad range of industries, anticipating and
meeting our customers’ changing needs with innovative solutions that combine high-specification
materials and dedicated technical support.

Everything we do is guided by our purpose:* material solutions advancing life*. Our products help to
build homes, cities and vehicles; to support the supply of renewable energy, food and clean water;
to create technologies such as smartphone display screens, printed circuit boards and
semiconductors.

We do this within a robust sustainability framework, always balancing economic performance with
environmental stewardship and social responsibility.

thyssenkrupp Materials Services ist ein globales Unternehmen mit rund 380 Standorten in über 30

### [Mit Vollgas in die Zukunft des Autos][27]

Profi-Sportler:innen und Musiker:innen hört man gelegentlich sagen, dass sie ihr Hobby zum Beruf
gemacht haben. Von Ingenieur:innen kommt ein solcher Satz hingegen eher selten. Eine Ausnahme ist

Aviation Fuel.

## Leading Manufacturer and Distributor

of Industrial Minerals, Blasting Equipment
and Related Materials and Services.

[Request A Quote][190]

# Industrial Mineral Manufacturer

AGSCO is a leading manufacturer and distributor of a variety of industrial chemicals and abrasives,
minerals and blasting equipment.  We provide minerals such as [silica sand][191], [pool
plasters][192], [mil-spec. materials][193], and more for a variety of different applications. We
also supply a wide range of aggregates for coating removal and surface preparation. Our team of
specialists are available to assist you in choosing the best material for your application. [Contact
us][194] today for more information!

[Minerals and Abrasives]

### Minerals and Abrasives

We carry a full line of industrial grade minerals & abrasives for a variety of applications and
industries.

[Learn More][195]
[Equipment]

### Equipment

We carry a full line of blasting equipment for your existing blasting operation or if you're looking
to get started in the business.

[Learn More][196]
[Custom Services]

### Custom Services

We provide a full line of custom mineral processing and toll services, including precise screening,
blending, coating, and private labeling.

## Leading Manufacturer and Distributor

of Industrial Minerals, Blasting Equipment
and Related Materials and Services.

[Request A Quote][190]

# Industrial Mineral Manufacturer

AGSCO is a leading manufacturer and distributor of a variety of industrial chemicals and abrasives,
minerals and blasting equipment.  We provide minerals such as [silica sand][191], [pool
plasters][192], [mil-spec. materials][193], and more for a variety of different applications. We
also supply a wide range of aggregates for coating removal and surface preparation. Our team of
specialists are available to assist you in choosing the best material for your application. [Contact
us][194] today for more information!

[Minerals and Abrasives]

### Minerals and Abrasives

We carry a full line of industrial grade minerals & abrasives for a variety of applications and
industries.

[Learn More][195]
[Equipment]

### Equipment

We carry a full line of blasting equipment for your existing blasting operation or if you're looking
to get started in the business.

[Learn More][196]
[Custom Services]

### Custom Services

We provide a full line of custom mineral processing and toll services, including precise screening,
blending, coating, and private labeling.

[Learn More][197]

# **One Provider
# for Global Health
# Insurance and Benefits
# **

International health insurance for Individuals and Employers.
Find the right plan for you below:

## **International Health Insurance for you and your family**

Working, studying or living abroad? Our international health insurance plans help protect expat
individuals, professionals, students and families as they work and live abroad. Explore our plans
and choose the international expat healthcare cover that’s perfect for you. Only away for less than
a year? Discover our short-term private health insurance for individuals and families.
[ INTERNATIONAL HEALTH INSURANCE (12+ MONTHS) ][106]
[ SHORT TERM HEALTH INSURANCE (3-9 MONTHS) ][107]
[Young women smiling at camera]

## **Consistent cover for your employees**

We understand that in today's globalized world, businesses often have employees spread across
different regions.  With our regional plans, you can ensure consistent and reliable coverage for
your employees worldwide. Our Summit plans are designed to meet the unique healthcare needs of each
region, while also ensuring compliance with local regulations. We provide administration services,
cover for insurance risks, or a combination of both.
[ GET A QUOTE ][108]
[Two people working together on a tablet]

You have access to a range of services gathered in one convenient hub to help protect you and your
family from preventable health risks. Our services include Telehealth Hub, Expat Assistance
programme, Fitness coaching App, Nutrition Hub, Travel Security and more.

[VIEW OUR PRODUCTS][17]

Alunite East Rand is an Aluminum and Glass company which specializes in the manufacturing, supply
and installation of standard or custom-made aluminium windows and doors, showers, patio, braai
enclosures and shop fronts. We also remove old or damaged wooden and steel windows and doors and
replace them with our aluminium products.

Our mission is to enrich the lives of our customers by providing the best value for money and by
offering the highest quality of products and services in the aluminum and glass industry.

You can choose from a variety of colors and styles in order to match your various products. Our
products are made from SABS approved aluminium, which is epoxy coated and is suitable for both
interior and exterior use. They are durable and weather proof.

We follow the code and ethical practice of the South African Glass and Glazing association (SAGGA)
and The Association of Architectural Aluminium Manufacturers of South Africa (AAAMSA). All products
are quality controlled and are installed by trained fitters.

## Manufacture:

We manufacture and fit standard and purpose made aluminium windows, shower doors, sliding doors,
patio/braai enclosures, sun rooms and shop fronts.

## Service:

We service aluminium sliding doors and windows. Safety Glass, Standard Clear and Obscure Glass are
cut to customers specifications and fitted on request.

## WE SPECIALISE IN:

• Aluminium Conversions
• Custom made Aluminium Frames To Any Size
• Servicing of Aluminium Windows & Doors

#### Welcome To Alunite Strand!
#### OVER 20 YEARS EXPERIENCE!

##### **What do we do?**

We manufacture and fit standard and purpose made aluminium windows, shower doors, sliding doors,
patio, braai enclosures, sun rooms and shop fronts.

We also remove old and damaged wooden and steel windows and replace them with aluminium.

We service aluminium sliding doors and windows.

Safety Glass, Standard Clear and Obscure Glass and Mirrors are cut to customers specifications and
fitted on request.

We cut and supply any type of glass and mirrors to size or shape.

## Une nouvelle gamme en 2026

### Titre h3

Résultat en matière d’écart de rémunération entre les femmes et les hommes pour l'année 2025 au
titre des données 2024
Index global non calculable, décliné par indicateurs comme suit :
1. Indicateur écart de rémunération : non calculable
2. Indicateur écart de taux d'augmentations : 15
3. Indicateur retour de congé maternité : non calculable
4. Indicateur hautes rémunérations: 5

À la date du 14/02/2025

## Se positionner pour un futur de plus en plus **vert.**

ARDÉA développe et commercialise pour le grand public des produits d’entretien, de bricolage et des
produits d’allumage.

Historiquement implantée en Franche-Comté, ARDÉA conditionne la quasi totalité des produits qu’elle 
commercialise sur le site de Roche lez Beaupré (60 000m² classé SEVESO bas) ce qui lui garantit un
taux de service supérieur à 98%.

Fort de ses différentes marques, ARDÉA répond aux besoins de l’ensemble de la distribution française
en produits solvants. Longtemps considéré comme un fournisseur de solvants rattaché à l’univers
peinture, ARDÉA se positionne pour le futur de plus en plus vers l’univers de l’entretien de la
maison grâce notamment à l’apport de produits d'origine naturelle développés ces dernières années
(vinaigres ménagers, bicarbonate de soude, etc.).

## La richesse d'une entreprise au service de 2 marques fortes

La dimension d’une société, au-delà des chiffres, se mesure à sa capacité à créer de la valeur
ajoutée à des produits. Ardéa a su se doter au fil du temps de marques puissantes, reconnues
nationalement.

Les marques **Onyx** et **Paulette** sont synonymes pour le consommateur d’efficacité, d’exigence et
de technicité. 

C’est dans la force et la cohérence de chacune de ses entités qu’ARDÉA tire toute sa richesse.

## Onyx

Gamme phare et historique de la société, elle représente la majorité du chiffre d’affaires. Décaper,
nettoyer, entretenir et protéger : toutes les nécessités du bricolage sont couvertes par une gamme
de produits riche et cohérente.

[ Voir le site Onyx ][3]

## Paulette

Paulette est née de l’imagination de nos équipes pour entrer dans le marché de l’entretien de la
grande distribution alimentaire. Nous proposons une gamme de produits authentiques remis au goût du
jour pour les utilisateurs en recherche de produits plus sains dans un esprit original. 

[ Voir le site Paulette ][4]

produits d’allumage.

Historiquement implantée en Franche-Comté, ARDÉA conditionne la quasi totalité des produits qu’elle 
commercialise sur le site de Roche lez Beaupré (60 000m² classé SEVESO bas) ce qui lui garantit un
taux de service supérieur à 98%.

Fort de ses différentes marques, ARDÉA répond aux besoins de l’ensemble de la distribution française
en produits solvants. Longtemps considéré comme un fournisseur de solvants rattaché à l’univers
peinture, ARDÉA se positionne pour le futur de plus en plus vers l’univers de l’entretien de la
maison grâce notamment à l’apport de produits d'origine naturelle développés ces dernières années
(vinaigres ménagers, bicarbonate de soude, etc.).

La dimension d’une société, au-delà des chiffres, se mesure à sa capacité à créer de la valeur
ajoutée à des produits. Ardéa a su se doter au fil du temps de marques puissantes, reconnues
nationalement.

Les marques **Onyx** et **Paulette** sont synonymes pour le consommateur d’efficacité, d’exigence et
de technicité. 

C’est dans la force et la cohérence de chacune de ses entités qu’ARDÉA tire toute sa richesse.

## Onyx

Gamme phare et historique de la société, elle représente la majorité du chiffre d’affaires. Décaper,
nettoyer, entretenir et protéger : toutes les nécessités du bricolage sont couvertes par une gamme
de produits riche et cohérente.

[ Voir le site Onyx ][3]

## Paulette

Paulette est née de l’imagination de nos équipes pour entrer dans le marché de l’entretien de la
grande distribution alimentaire. Nous proposons une gamme de produits authentiques remis au goût du
jour pour les utilisateurs en recherche de produits plus sains dans un esprit original.

The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone

* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

## Gems & Minerals

### Easy-to-understand resources on gemstones and minerals—for beginners, collectors, students, and
### professionals.

[LEARN MORE][35]

## OVERVIEW

### Discover the World of Gems & Minerals

From ancient crystals formed deep within the Earth to vibrant gemstones treasured for their beauty
and rarity, our site is your gateway to everything geological. Whether you’re a curious beginner, a
passionate collector, a student of mineralogy, or simply fascinated by nature’s brilliance, you’ll
find reliable, engaging information to fuel your fascination.

Explore detailed profiles of hundreds of gems and minerals, learn how to identify stones with
confidence, and uncover the science behind their unique properties. With visual guides, interactive
tools, and expert insights, we make the complex world of geology accessible and exciting for
everyone.

## Conduct Research With Our Comprehensive List of Minerals in Alphabetical Order

**Explore the Fascinating World of Minerals**
Minerals are the natural building blocks of the Earth—each with a unique structure, composition, and
purpose. From common quartz to rare crystalline specimens, minerals shape the rocks beneath our feet
and power the tools we use every day. Dive into our comprehensive guide to learn how minerals form,
how they’re identified, and why they matter—from geology and industry to collecting and display.

Browse minerals by first letter

## Discover the Beauty and History of Gems

Gems are nature’s most captivating treasures—prized for their color, brilliance, rarity, and rich
cultural symbolism. From diamonds and emeralds to opals and tourmalines, gemstones have been
cherished across civilizations for their beauty and meaning. Learn how gems are formed, classified,
cut, and used in everything from jewelry to ancient rituals. Explore famous stones, ethical
sourcing, and the science behind their sparkle in our in-depth guide to the world of gemstones.

[LEARN MORE][62]

## Educational
* **Gem & Mineral Directory**: A searchable collection of entries, each with info like name,
  classification, hardness, luster, streak, color, formation, and uses.
* **Identification Guide**: Tools and charts to help users identify unknown stones based on physical
  properties.
* **Hardness Scale (Mohs Scale)**: Visual and interactive explanation of mineral hardness.
* **Crystal Systems**: Diagrams and examples of different crystal structures (cubic, hexagonal,
  etc.).
* **Formation & Geology**: How different types of gems and minerals are formed (igneous,
  sedimentary, metamorphic).
* **Mineral Properties Explained**: Cleavage, fracture, streak, luster, etc.—what they mean and how
  to test them.
* **Gemstone Treatments & Enhancements**: Educate visitors on heat treatments, dyeing, irradiation,
  etc.

[LEARN MORE][63]

## Collector-Focused
* **Specimen Spotlight**: Rotating feature on a rare or interesting stone.
* **Top 10 Must-Have Minerals**: Curated list for new collectors.
* **How to Start a Collection**: Beginner tips on buying, storing, and displaying minerals.
* **Care & Cleaning Tips**: How to protect and preserve delicate specimens.
* **Fake vs. Real**: Help users spot synthetic or imitation stones.

[LEARN MORE][64]

## About & Contact
* **Submit a Mineral**: Let users contribute knowledge, photos, or ID requests.
* **Contact Us**: For questions, collaborations, or purchases.

[LEARN MORE][65]

## Gems & Minerals

### Easy-to-understand resources on gemstones and minerals—for beginners, collectors, students, and
### professionals.

[LEARN MORE][35]

## OVERVIEW

### Discover the World of Gems & Minerals

From ancient crystals formed deep within the Earth to vibrant gemstones treasured for their beauty
and rarity, our site is your gateway to everything geological. Whether you’re a curious beginner, a
passionate collector, a student of mineralogy, or simply fascinated by nature’s brilliance, you’ll
find reliable, engaging information to fuel your fascination.

Explore detailed profiles of hundreds of gems and minerals, learn how to identify stones with
confidence, and uncover the science behind their unique properties. With visual guides, interactive
tools, and expert insights, we make the complex world of geology accessible and exciting for
everyone.

## Conduct Research With Our Comprehensive List of Minerals in Alphabetical Order

**Explore the Fascinating World of Minerals**
Minerals are the natural building blocks of the Earth—each with a unique structure, composition, and
purpose. From common quartz to rare crystalline specimens, minerals shape the rocks beneath our feet
and power the tools we use every day. Dive into our comprehensive guide to learn how minerals form,
how they’re identified, and why they matter—from geology and industry to collecting and display.

## Discover the Beauty and History of Gems

Gems are nature’s most captivating treasures—prized for their color, brilliance, rarity, and rich
cultural symbolism. From diamonds and emeralds to opals and tourmalines, gemstones have been
cherished across civilizations for their beauty and meaning. Learn how gems are formed, classified,
cut, and used in everything from jewelry to ancient rituals. Explore famous stones, ethical
sourcing, and the science behind their sparkle in our in-depth guide to the world of gemstones.

[LEARN MORE][62]

## Educational
* **Gem & Mineral Directory**: A searchable collection of entries, each with info like name,
  classification, hardness, luster, streak, color, formation, and uses.
* **Identification Guide**: Tools and charts to help users identify unknown stones based on physical
  properties.
* **Hardness Scale (Mohs Scale)**: Visual and interactive explanation of mineral hardness.
* **Crystal Systems**: Diagrams and examples of different crystal structures (cubic, hexagonal,
  etc.).
* **Formation & Geology**: How different types of gems and minerals are formed (igneous,
  sedimentary, metamorphic).
* **Mineral Properties Explained**: Cleavage, fracture, streak, luster, etc.—what they mean and how
  to test them.
* **Gemstone Treatments & Enhancements**: Educate visitors on heat treatments, dyeing, irradiation,
  etc.

[LEARN MORE][63]

## Collector-Focused
* **Specimen Spotlight**: Rotating feature on a rare or interesting stone.
* **Top 10 Must-Have Minerals**: Curated list for new collectors.
* **How to Start a Collection**: Beginner tips on buying, storing, and displaying minerals.
* **Care & Cleaning Tips**: How to protect and preserve delicate specimens.
* **Fake vs. Real**: Help users spot synthetic or imitation stones.

[LEARN MORE][64]

## About & Contact
* **Submit a Mineral**: Let users contribute knowledge, photos, or ID requests.
* **Contact Us**: For questions, collaborations, or purchases.

[LEARN MORE][65]

## GET IN TOUCH

#### **Italian Sculptural Design**

## Not Simply Furniture. Objects Designed To Be Remembered.

Mavimatt creates handmade Italian design furniture, sculptural objects and collectible pieces for
luxury contemporary interiors around the world. Crafted in Italy through a combination of artistic
vision, craftsmanship and material research, each piece transforms function into a distinctive
design statement. Beyond furniture, Mavimatt pieces bring atmosphere, identity and emotional impact
into the spaces they inhabit, offering a different way to experience Italian design.

FEATURED

## ALUNITE

Our first object that will illuminate your interiors
[ Discover More ][17]
FEATURED

Sculptural comfort inspired by futuristic forms.
[ Discover More ][18]
FEATURED

A soft object that blends art and functionality.
[ Discover More ][19]
FEATURED

### NINFEA

Functional design crafted with artistic details.
[ Discover More ][20]

## Voices From Mavimatt Clients

> “A design and a quality that I had never seen before, I love everything they do”

L.N

> “Я приехал из Санкт-Петербурга и был их клиентом в течение долгого времени, я купил у них
> несколько продуктов для своего дома, я могу сказать, что они имеют такое высокое качество,
> которого я никогда не видел. Более того, я очень доволен ими, потому что они всегда доступны в
> любое время, и им удается выполнить любую специальную настройку, которую я хочу. Номер один, очень
> хорошо”

A.K

> “私は東京に住んでいて、ソーシャルネットワークのおかげでこのイタリアのブランドに気づきました。彼ら
> が何をしているかを見てすぐに彼らに連絡するのをためらうことなく、私は屋根裏部屋にMAGMAコンソールと2
> つのUFOアームチェアを購入し、数か月待ちました彼らの生産は完全に職人的であるので、製品が到着したと
> き、私は言葉がなかったので、こんなに高品質で美しいデザインを見たことはありませんでした。間違いなく
> 他の商品も買います。お世辞”

F.L.O

> “I became aware of this italian brand thanks to a friend of mine who had bought one of their
> U.F.O. chairs for his house, and as soon as i saw it, i was fascinated and i wanted to find out
> more about them, so i got in touch with them and in the end i also could not give up adding their
> own masterpiece of design to my apartment. Unreachable, unique quality. Compliments”

R.O

> “I bought their NINFEA table, and with a great pleasure at the delivery of the product, the owner
> of the brand came personally to install it in my house, a truly special person with a unique
> vision in the world of design. The quality of their products is spectacular”

S.L.A

> “Seguo questo marchio da diversi anni, sono riusciti a creare oggetti che trasmettono emozioni e
> credo che questa sia la chiave del successo che stanno avendo, complimenti, non posso che
> continuare a farmi stupire dalle loro creazioni”

M.R

# Omya ranked #7 globally in chemical distribution

##### Our combined businesses, Omya Specialty Materials and Omya Performance Polymer Distribution,
##### are ranked 3rd in Europe and 7th globally in the 2025 ICIS top 100 chemical distributors
##### listing.

[Read more][248]
[Omya Specialty Materials Hero Image]

# Omya Specialty Materials

##### One-stop shop technical solutions for customers worldwide through the global distribution of
##### minerals and chemicals.

[Learn more about Omya Specialty Materials][249]
[Science Molecule DNA Model Structure, business teamwork concept 270524519]

# Omya Performance Polymer Distribution

##### Your global distribution partner for high-performance, engineering and standard polymers, and
##### rubber polymers and additives.

[Discover Omya Performance Polymer Distribution][250]

## Our business units
* [
  
  ## Omya Specialty Materials
  
  Global sales and distribution for a wide range of specialist minerals, pigments, binders,
  additives, and life science ingredients.
  [OSM header]
  ][251]
* [
  
  ## Omya Performance Polymer Distribution
  
  Global distribution of high-performance, engineering and standard polymers, and rubber polymers
  and additives.
  [OPPD_Header_image]
  ][252]

## Thinking of Tomorrow

For over 140 years, Omya has been using natural minerals and chemistry to improve life for current
and future generations. Our scientists work closely with customers and partners across the world,
using our Horizon Framework to consider the short, medium and long term issues facing our planet and
society.

[Learn more about innovation][253]

## Omya is a leading global producer of essential minerals and a worldwide distributor of specialty
## materials.

[Explore our story][254]

### Technical expertise and application development

With scientists in 50 countries and 17 dedicated laboratories across the world, Omya offers
laboratory analysis, technical expertise, and application development to customers and partners
globally.

 

We support process efficiencies, formulation optimization, and functionality improvements to
increase performance.

[Learn more about innovation][255]
[Innovation]

## Sustainability is key to our success and that of our customers

At Omya, sustainability is at the heart of everything we do. Our approach is twofold: we focus on
enhancing our own performance across social, environmental, and economic dimensions, and we are
dedicated to helping our customers achieve their sustainability goals.

 

Our natural mineral solutions are designed to have a low carbon footprint, offering a more
sustainable alternative to many of the materials they replace.

[Learn more][256]
[Sunlight in the green forest]

## Join the Omya team

With 9,000 people employed across more than 50 countries, Omya offers exceptional career
opportunities to talented individuals with the determination to succeed.

 

If you have a passion for minerals and chemistry, and would like to be part of our team, we’d love
to hear from you.

[See our job openings][257]
[Career opportunities at Omya]

At Omya, we take a long-term approach to business, ensuring sustainability and growth for both our

For over 140 years, Omya has been using natural minerals and chemistry to improve life for current

With scientists in 50 countries and 17 dedicated laboratories across the world, Omya offers

At Omya, sustainability is at the heart of everything we do. Our approach is twofold: we focus on

sustainable alternative to many of the materials they replace.

all-natural gem quality turquoise which has not been artificially treated or colored. **            
                                                                                                    
**We produce the majority of the turquoise we offer for sale from our own mines which are located in
some of America's finest southwestern turquoise mining regions. Native American turquoise jewelry   
designers have used the gems from these mines for decades - now we can supply that same turquoise   
directly to you. We have both loose cut stones and spectacular silver turquoise jewelry in a classy 
and contemporary form that you may not have seen previously. Rings, pendants, bracelets and         
earrings, we have it all when it comes to high quality silver turquoise jewelry, and we skip the    
middle man to offer it direct from the miner to you at a low wholesale price.**                     
                                                                                                    
** Gemstones From Around the World**                                                                
                                                                                                    
**Although we feature southwestern American Turquoise, we also have a wonderful supplies of other   
gemstones from around the world. Loose stones and jewelry in Tanzanite, Tsavorite garnet, Sapphire, 
Tourmaline and Oregon Sunstone - plus many, many others - we pretty much have a great selection and 
can supply you with all your favorite colored stones. So whether its rings, bracelets or other      
jewelry for the collector, or loose gemstones for the jewelry designer wanting to make that unique  
piece, we have a great selection of all your favorites, even a little bit of rough and and some very
rare natural gemstone crystal specimens. **                                                         
                                                                                                    
**So come on in and check out our site, take the virtual tour of our Nevada turquoise mines - see   
the variety of gorgeous loose gems we have and view our very classy, contemporary silver turquoise  
jewelry. We also have some very special gems and fine jewelry featuring gemstones other than        
turquoise - from both from American sources as well as other locations world wide.** ** We know and 
understand your gemstone passions, as we collect these all these gems ourselves - Turquoise,        
Tanzanite, Oregon Sunstone, Tsavorite - we appreciate the crystalline beauty from the earth. That's 
why we have created this web site - to share the jewelry we have designed, the gems we have mined or
cut, and spread our enthusiasm by offering the knowledge that we have gained. Because we harvest    
these treasures of the earth ourselves, we also are sharing some of our adventures in the field     
prospecting for both turquoise and natural gold nuggets. We welcome your purchases, and will do our 
very best to make your transactions smooth, safe and easy. **

# Panjiva Supply Chain Intelligence Data-driven insights for the global trade community

[Plans and Pricing][13] [Request a Demo][14] [Free Newsletter][15]

## The Panjiva Difference

Panjiva is an intelligence platform that’s bringing transparency to global trade through our robust
global coverage, powerful machine-learning technologies, and dynamic data visualizations. Whether
you’re looking to identify potential business partners, keep track of competitors, or find
investment signals, our platform arms you with unrivaled insights to make supply chain decisions
with conviction. [Learn more][16]

## Smart & Intuitive Analytics

Our platform takes the power of **machine learning** and **data visualization** to give you clear,
actionable insights on global trade.

[Watch Demo][17]

## Find and evaluate legitimate businesses, faster

### 9 million companies and over 2 billion shipment records, just a few seconds away

#### Search for Importers and Exports

Our technology gives you immediate insight into the companies involved at every node of
international supply chains. From manufacturers and buyers to shipping and logistics, Panjiva allows
customers to better understand trade around the globe.

#### Take the data with you

Building a lead list for your sales team? Easily export the results and share them with your team to
expand their reach.

[[Screenshot-supplier-search-for-shirts]][18]
[Supplier Search for shirts]

#### Search your way

Whether you are searching for a product by name or classification, we make it easy. We support
commodity name, HS / HTS code, *D-U-N-S® Number*, and location-based searches.

#### Receive periodic email alerts

Save your search and receive email alerts anytime a new company matches your search criteria, or
when an existing company has new shipment activity.

## A Clear View of Each Company’s Activities

### Information and insights from authoritative customs and business information databases melded
### together to give a 360 degree view of businesses worldwide.

[[An example Panjiva Profile]][19]
[An example Panjiva Profile]

#### Actionable Insights

Powerful reporting capabilities let you spot trends in the import and export activities businesses
across the globe.

#### Top Customers & Suppliers

Discover new opportunities by seeing who does business with your peers or competitors.

#### Contact Information

Access the emails or phone numbers of key decision makers on over 1 million companies.

## A Comprehensive View of Global Trade

### We provide our clients with transactional data covering 35% of global trade flows.
### Armed with this data, you can decide where and when to invest.

#### Competitive Insights

Understand your market share by seeing where your competitors source their goods, and which entities
are involved in the shipment of goods.

#### Risk Analysis

Use our [platform][20] to analyze trade lanes or identify which companies have the riskiest supply
chains.

#### Sales Leads

Whether you’re targeting buyers, suppliers, NVOCCs, or carriers, Panjiva makes it easy to identify
the best sales prospects, learn more about their business, and make contact.

#### Xpressfeed™ Access Available

Use [Xpressfeed™][21] to push leads directly into your CRM system or feed data about publicly-traded
companies into your quant models.

[[Screenshot-network-view-diagram]][22]

### From Supply Chain Research

[[2026-07-17-sce-involution-600x370]][23]

##### [Supply Chain Edge: Evolving involution, forecasting transport prices, sourcing Ukraine’s
##### electronics][24]

July 17, 2026

– Mainland China’s anti-involution campaign is set to remain a supply chain policy priority even as
producer prices return to inflation, with the focus shifting from broad capacity cuts to demand
repair, investment discipline and higher returns on capital. The US removal of de minimis...

[More research articles ][25]

## Robust global coverage. Powerful machine learning technologies. Dynamic data visualizations.
## Surge ahead of the competition with Panjiva Supply Chain Intelligence.

# Panjiva Supply Chain Intelligence Data-driven insights for the global trade community

[Plans and Pricing][13] [Request a Demo][14] [Free Newsletter][15]

## The Panjiva Difference

Panjiva is an intelligence platform that’s bringing transparency to global trade through our robust
global coverage, powerful machine-learning technologies, and dynamic data visualizations. Whether
you’re looking to identify potential business partners, keep track of competitors, or find
investment signals, our platform arms you with unrivaled insights to make supply chain decisions
with conviction. [Learn more][16]

## Smart & Intuitive Analytics

Our platform takes the power of **machine learning** and **data visualization** to give you clear,
actionable insights on global trade.

[Watch Demo][17]

## Find and evaluate legitimate businesses, faster

### 9 million companies and over 2 billion shipment records, just a few seconds away

#### Search for Importers and Exports

Our technology gives you immediate insight into the companies involved at every node of
international supply chains. From manufacturers and buyers to shipping and logistics, Panjiva allows
customers to better understand trade around the globe.

#### Take the data with you

Building a lead list for your sales team? Easily export the results and share them with your team to
expand their reach.

[[Screenshot-supplier-search-for-shirts]][18]
[Supplier Search for shirts]

#### Search your way

Whether you are searching for a product by name or classification, we make it easy. We support
commodity name, HS / HTS code, *D-U-N-S® Number*, and location-based searches.

#### Receive periodic email alerts

Save your search and receive email alerts anytime a new company matches your search criteria, or
when an existing company has new shipment activity.

## A Clear View of Each Company’s Activities

### Information and insights from authoritative customs and business information databases melded
### together to give a 360 degree view of businesses worldwide.

[[An example Panjiva Profile]][19]
[An example Panjiva Profile]

#### Actionable Insights

Powerful reporting capabilities let you spot trends in the import and export activities businesses
across the globe.

#### Top Customers & Suppliers

Discover new opportunities by seeing who does business with your peers or competitors.

#### Contact Information

Access the emails or phone numbers of key decision makers on over 1 million companies.

## A Comprehensive View of Global Trade

### We provide our clients with transactional data covering 35% of global trade flows.
### Armed with this data, you can decide where and when to invest.

#### Competitive Insights

Understand your market share by seeing where your competitors source their goods, and which entities
are involved in the shipment of goods.

#### Risk Analysis

Use our [platform][20] to analyze trade lanes or identify which companies have the riskiest supply
chains.

#### Sales Leads

Whether you’re targeting buyers, suppliers, NVOCCs, or carriers, Panjiva makes it easy to identify
the best sales prospects, learn more about their business, and make contact.

#### Xpressfeed™ Access Available

Use [Xpressfeed™][21] to push leads directly into your CRM system or feed data about publicly-traded
companies into your quant models.

# Low-cost Producer

**SOPerior Fertilizer** is a near term producer of premium SOP (sulphate of potash) fertilizer,
alumina, and sulphuric acid from its massive Blawn Mountain Alunite resource asset in Utah. Surface
mining and processing alunite using conventional industry methods yields alumina, SOP, and sulphuric
acid. With three valuable commodities being produced from processing a single ore stream it is
projected that the project will yield lowest in class production costs. All 3 product streams have
strong domestic markets and the chosen project site has excellent mainline rail access to east, west
and gulf coast markets.

The company is in the process of closing a Joint Venture development agreement with a strategic
partner to get a first phase production facility financed and constructed.

**SOPerior Fertilizer** is a near term producer of premium SOP (sulphate of potash) fertilizer,
alumina, and sulphuric acid from its massive Blawn Mountain Alunite resource asset in Utah. Surface
mining and processing alunite using conventional industry methods yields alumina, SOP, and sulphuric
acid. With three valuable commodities being produced from processing a single ore stream it is
projected that the project will yield lowest in class production costs. All 3 product streams have
strong domestic markets and the chosen project site has excellent mainline rail access to east, west
and gulf coast markets.

# Mineral^{©} takes the guesswork out of HR and compliance.

### The top-rated HR and compliance platform.

### Manage HR and compliance. All in one place.

If you’ve been stringing together incompatible tools and Googling answers, you deserve a massive
upgrade.  

Mineral gives you one place to turn for all the tools, answers, and best practices to stay ahead of
the curve – for all the states you operate in.

### A few examples of what you can do with Mineral:
* Assess your HR health
* Get expert advice on HR and legal issues
* Create an employee handbook
* Create job descriptions
* Compare salaries
* Train employees on essential skills
* Create benefits documents
* And much, much, more

[Learn more about our products ][93]

### You’re too busy to keep up with HR and compliance. So don’t.

Whether or not HR is in your job title, it’s impossible to keep up with ever-changing state and
federal laws and policies. With Mineral, you don’t have to.

We take the guesswork out of HR and compliance so you can manage workplace challenges with
confidence.

[Learn more about our solutions][94]

technology and human expertise, Mineral ensures you won’t be caught off guard when laws and
regulations change. 


With Mineral Platform™, you get anytime access to essential tools and resources, plus state and
federal compliance guidance you can actually understand and use.

[Learn about Mineral Platform][100]


Mineral Intelligence™ gives you personalized, real-time alerts and to-dos so you can protect your
business and stay ahead of the compliance curve.

[Learn about Mineral Intelligence][101]


Our Mineral Experts™ team of HR and legal experts dispenses advice on everything from hiring and
firing to leaves of absence, discrimination and more.

# **Explore America’s Ghost Towns**

**Discover the [forgotten history][11] of abandoned towns across the United States**

[**Browse by State**][12]
[**Adventuring Gear**][13]

## **Explore Ghost Towns By Category**

[Agrarian Ghost Towns]

### Agrarian Ghost Towns

**Once-thriving farming communities abandoned during the 1930s agricultural decline. The Great
Depression and Dust Bowl forced families from their land, leaving behind empty homesteads, desolate
streets, and rural schools. Explore farming settlements that withered as technology advanced and
farms consolidated.**

[Explore][14]
[Coastal Ghost Towns of America]

### Coastal Ghost Towns of America

**Seaside communities abandoned to the relentless forces of nature and changing maritime industries.
From [submerged towns][15] like Bayocean to hurricane-ravaged settlements, these coastal relics tell
tales of fishing villages, shipbuilding centers, and beach resorts that flourished before being
reclaimed by tides.**

[Explore][16]
[Midwest Haunted Ghost Towns]

### Midwest Haunted Ghost Towns

**Abandoned communities across America’s heartland with rich histories and spectral residents. From
Missouri’s “bloodiest 47 acres” at the State Penitentiary to Wisconsin’s Pfister Hotel, these
forgotten towns feature infamous hauntings, unexplained phenomena, and preserved structures from the
1800s.**

[Explore][17]
[Appalachian Ghost Towns]

### Appalachian Ghost Towns

**Discover towns nestled in mountain hollows, many now submerged beneath man-made lakes. These
communities once thrived on coal mining, timber harvesting, and railroad commerce until industry
departed. Some, like Proctor, NC, rest beneath the waters of Fontana Lake, visible only during
drought seasons.**

[Explore][18]
[Colonial Ghost Town Heritage]

### Colonial Ghost Town Heritage

**America’s earliest abandoned settlements, including [17th-century sites][19] like Zwaanendael
(Delaware) founded before the United States existed. These colonial-era towns were abandoned due to
native conflicts, disease outbreaks, or economic failures, leaving behind centuries-old foundations
and archaeological treasures.**

[Explore][20]
[Military Ghost Town Sites]

### Military Ghost Town Sites

**Former bases, forts, and defense installations abandoned as military strategies evolved. Explore
Cold War relics like Saint Marie, Montana (decommissioned 1976), Civil War-era fortifications, and
WWII installations with parade grounds, barracks, and operations buildings slowly returning to
nature.**

[Explore][21]
[Civil War Ghost Towns]

### Civil War Ghost Towns

**Settlements abandoned during or after the Civil War, including battle-damaged communities at
Sharpsburg, Gettysburg, and Chickamauga. These towns bear witness to America’s bloodiest conflict,
with stories of phantom soldiers still marching and historic structures frozen in time since 1865.**

[Explore][22]
[Forgotten Frontier Ghost Towns]

### Forgotten Frontier Ghost Towns

**The iconic ghost towns of the American West, where boom-and-bust mining economies created instant
cities that vanished just as quickly. Explore over 2,000 abandoned settlements where prospectors
sought gold, silver, and copper fortunes, leaving behind saloons, hotels, and mine works when
deposits ran dry.**

[Explore][23]
[Southern Suburban Ghost Towns]

### Southern Suburban Ghost Towns

**Communities throughout the South that boomed during various economic cycles before declining. From
Texas oil towns to Alabama textile communities, these settlements often feature beautiful antebellum
architecture, abandoned plantations, and forgotten industrial complexes unique to Southern
history.**

[Explore][24]

## Discover More Ghost Towns

[View All States and Categories][25]

## Featured Ghost Towns

[abandoned pennsylvania ghost town]Yellow Springs, Pennsylvania

## **Spotlight:** Yellow Springs, Pennsylvania Ghost Town

**You’ll find Yellow Springs nestled in Pennsylvania’s historic coal country, where natural mineral
springs first drew health-seeking visitors in the 1700s. The village transformed from an exclusive
spa resort into a thriving mining community in the 1850s, complete with innovative rail systems and
extensive tunnel networks. By the 1870s, poor-quality coal and depleted timber resources led to its
abandonment, leaving behind mysterious ruins in St. Anthony’s Wilderness that tell a deeper story.**

[Read the Full Story][26]

### Agrarian Ghost Towns

**Once-thriving farming communities abandoned during the 1930s agricultural decline. The Great
Depression and Dust Bowl forced families from their land, leaving behind empty homesteads, desolate
streets, and rural schools. Explore farming settlements that withered as technology advanced and
farms consolidated.**

### Coastal Ghost Towns of America

tales of fishing villages, shipbuilding centers, and beach resorts that flourished before being

### Midwest Haunted Ghost Towns

**Abandoned communities across America’s heartland with rich histories and spectral residents. From
Missouri’s “bloodiest 47 acres” at the State Penitentiary to Wisconsin’s Pfister Hotel, these
forgotten towns feature infamous hauntings, unexplained phenomena, and preserved structures from the
1800s.**

[Appalachian Ghost Towns]

### Appalachian Ghost Towns

**Discover towns nestled in mountain hollows, many now submerged beneath man-made lakes. These
communities once thrived on coal mining, timber harvesting, and railroad commerce until industry
departed. Some, like Proctor, NC, rest beneath the waters of Fontana Lake, visible only during

native conflicts, disease outbreaks, or economic failures, leaving behind centuries-old foundations
and archaeological treasures.**

**Former bases, forts, and defense installations abandoned as military strategies evolved. Explore
Cold War relics like Saint Marie, Montana (decommissioned 1976), Civil War-era fortifications, and
WWII installations with parade grounds, barracks, and operations buildings slowly returning to
nature.**

[Explore][21]
[Civil War Ghost Towns]

### Civil War Ghost Towns

**Settlements abandoned during or after the Civil War, including battle-damaged communities at
Sharpsburg, Gettysburg, and Chickamauga. These towns bear witness to America’s bloodiest conflict,
with stories of phantom soldiers still marching and historic structures frozen in time since 1865.**

[Forgotten Frontier Ghost Towns]

### Forgotten Frontier Ghost Towns

**The iconic ghost towns of the American West, where boom-and-bust mining economies created instant
cities that vanished just as quickly. Explore over 2,000 abandoned settlements where prospectors
sought gold, silver, and copper fortunes, leaving behind saloons, hotels, and mine works when
deposits ran dry.**

[Southern Suburban Ghost Towns]

**Communities throughout the South that boomed during various economic cycles before declining. From
Texas oil towns to Alabama textile communities, these settlements often feature beautiful antebellum
architecture, abandoned plantations, and forgotten industrial complexes unique to Southern
history.**

# Welcome To UtahRails.net

Index For This Page

This page was last updated on May 5, 2026.

Here at UtahRails.net, our aim is to provide in-depth historical information about railroading in
Utah.

Any story about Utah's railroads must also include background information about the industries the
railroads serve, so you will also find information about mining companies, canning companies, and
grain and flour mills and elevators, and eventually, any company that shipped anything in a railroad
car.

You will also find extensive research and information about the various mining districts in Utah,
and the railroads that served them directly.

Along with Utah's fascinating railroad history, we also have available lots of history of the
equipment of Utah's railroads, such as locomotives, cabooses, passenger cars, and freight cars, for
railroads that operated in Utah, including Union Pacific, D&RGW, Utah Railway, and Kennecott Copper.

At times it seems we've only scratched the surface, but progress is being made. This is truly a work
in progress, so please come back often.

## Index Pages

[Utah Railroads][6] -- Index page for the history of railroading in Utah, along with other
information about Utah's history, including railroad-related industrial and business history.

[Union Pacific][7] -- Index page for Union Pacific Railroad, its history, its operations in Utah,
and its locomotive and caboose fleets.

[Rio Grande][8] -- Index page for Rio Grande in Utah, and its locomotives and cars.

[Utah Railway][9] -- Index page for Utah Railway, including full rosters of the road's steam and
diesel locomotives. Also included is the history of Utah Railway as part of the coal mines that the
company served beginning in 1912.

[Southern Pacific][10] -- Index page for Southern Pacific in Utah, including some limited SP
locomotive information.

[Western Pacific][11] -- Index page for Western Pacific in Utah, including some limited WP
locomotive information.

[UTA's TRAX and Frontrunner][12] -- Index page for Utah Transit Authority's TRAX light rail and
Frontrunner commuter rail, including information about older street railroads and buses.

[Streetcars and Street Railroads][13] -- Index page for Street Railroads, Streetcars and Trolleys in
Utah, including the streetcars of Salt Lake City, Ogden, Logan, and Provo, along with information
about the bus systems in Utah (Salt Lake City Lines, UTA, etc.).

[Amtrak In Utah][14] -- Index page for Amtrak in Utah, including information about former Amtrak
routes through Utah, and Amtrak cars and locomotives.

[Bingham Canyon][15] -- "To Move A Mountain" -- Index page with narrative history and research notes
about railroads and mining in Utah's Bingham Canyon, including Kennecott Utah Copper's railroad
locomotives.

[Utah Coal][16] -- "Utah Fuels The West" -- Index page with narrative history and research notes
about Utah's coal mining industry, and the railroads that served it.

[Industry Index][17] -- Index page for industries in Utah, and the railroads that served them.

[Mechanical Refrigeration][18] -- Information about mechanical refrigeration of railroad
refrigerator cars and the history of mechanical refrigeration before being used by the railroads.
Includes links to manufacturers.

[Mining Index][19] -- Index page for mining in Utah, and the railroads that served the mines, mills
and smelters.

[Locomotive Notes][20] -- Index page for diesel locomotives, including information about the history
of EMD and Alco.

[Andre Kristopans GM Data][21] -- Index page for Andre's former "GM Locomotive Serial Numbers Page,"
previously hosted at MSN TV (formerly WebTV).

[Andre Kristopans Bus and Transit Data][22] -- Index page for bus and transit data compiled by Andre
Kristopans.

[On-Line Articles][23] -- Index page for on-line versions (text-only) of many of my books and
magazine articles, updated and edited for publication to the web.

[Print Publications][24] -- Index page for the books and magazine articles that I have had
published.

[Passenger Cars][25] -- Index page for passenger cars and passenger trains.

[Rosters][26] -- Index page for rosters of locomotives and other equipment, including UP locomotive,
UP, cabooses, UP passenger cars.

[Buses][27] -- Index page for bus information.

[PDF][28] -- Index page for PDF files that relate to Utah railroads.

[Maps][31] -- An index page for Google Maps, and other maps showing locations for railroads in Utah.

[Scanned Maps and Drawings][32] -- A collection of scanned maps and schematic drawings produced in
the 1906 to 1972 time period, showing railroad trackage, facilities and structures for railroads in
the State of Utah.

[Wall Maps][33] -- A photo album with 22 scanned images of railroad wall maps. The railroads include
AT&SF (1979), BN (1971), BN (1986), C&NW (1985; 2 sides), Conrail (1986), CSX (no date), N&W (1977;

railroad maps held by the Utah Historical Society.

[Government Land Office Maps][36] -- Link to main search page for U. S. Government Land Office maps.

clearances (Plate C, Plate F, etc.) used for rail equipment on North American railroads.

etc.)][38] -- Information about the American Association of Railroads (AAR) Mechanical Designation

[Evanston Roundhouse][45] -- Information about the roundhouse and shops at Evanston, Wyoming.

[Highways][47] -- Information about the highway projects that affected the railroads of Utah.

numbering system used by Salt Lake County.

# Welcome to Western Mining History

Mining Regions of the Western United States

The image above illustrates the incredible scale of the mining regions of the western United States.
Yellow dots are gold mines, black dots are non-gold mines. Map icons show the distribution of
historic mining towns. An interactive version of this map is available [here][23].

## The Black Oak Mine

The Black Oak Mine, located near Soulsbyville, California, was a gold producer that operated
intermittently from 1878 through the 1920s. These exclusive photographs were provided by a
descendant of the mine's superintendent.  [Continue Reading][24]

## Featured Mining Town: Pioneer, Montana

[[Featured Mining Town: Pioneer, Montana]][25]

Pioneer grew out of mining activity in the Pioneer District, the site of Montana's first documented
gold discovery. Gold was discovered here in 1852, but the deposits were initially considered too
low-grade to trigger a major rush. Additional discoveries prior to 1866 renewed interest in the
district, although many prospectors were soon lured away by richer strikes elsewhere in western
Montana.  [Continue Reading][26]

## Featured Mining Town: Hamilton, Nevada

[[Featured Mining Town: Hamilton, Nevada]][27]

Established during the White Pine silver rush of 1868, Hamilton became the county seat and
commercial center of the White Pine district. Although the boom was short-lived, Hamilton continued
to serve the region for more than half a century.  [Continue Reading][28]

## Featured Mining Town: Sunrise, Wyoming

[[Featured Mining Town: Sunrise, Wyoming]][29]

Sunrise, Wyoming, was the site of one of the most significant iron-mining operations in the American
West, remaining in production for more than eighty years. A company town was established here, and
remained and active community until the 1960s.  [Continue Reading][30]

## Featured Mining Town: Tombstone, Arizona

[[Featured Mining Town: Tombstone, Arizona]][31]

Tombstone, Arizona is best known for the Earp brothers, Doc Holliday, and the gunfight at the OK
Corral. While most people probably know that Tombstone was a mining town, the fact that it was one
of the West's largest silver bonanza's has been overshadowed by the famous events surrounding the
legendary gun battle.  [Continue Reading][32]

## Featured Mining Town: Anyox, British Columbia

[[Featured Mining Town: Anyox, British Columbia]][33]

Anyox was a remote company town operated by the Granby Consolidated Mining, Smelting and Power
Company, which produced primarily copper, with lesser quantities of silver and gold, from 1914 to
1935. Situated roughly 600 miles (1,000 km) north of Vancouver and accessible only by sea, the
construction of a large industrial complex and a community of approximately 2,500 residents
represented a significant logistical and engineering achievement.  [Continue Reading][34]

## The Mines of Boulder County, Colorado: Photographs by Joseph Sturtevant

Joseph Sturtevant, also known as "Rocky Mountain Joe", was a professional photographer based in
Boulder, Colorado. During his time there, the mining industry in Boulder County was thriving, and he
documented much of it in photographs throughout the 1890s and the first decade of the twentieth
century.  [Continue Reading][35]

## Featured Mining Town: Pardee, Montana

[[Featured Mining Town: Pardee, Montana]][36]

Pardee was established at the Iron Mountain Mine, one of Montana's leading silver mines during the
1890s. The mine had its most productive years between 1891 and 1896.  [Continue Reading][37]

## Featured Mining Town: Shermantown, Nevada

[[Featured Mining Town: Shermantown, Nevada]][38]

Shermantown was one of the first three settlements founded in 1868 during the White Pine silver
rush. Established as a milling center for the Treasure Hill mines, its site was chosen not only for
its proximity to the mining operations but also for its comparatively mild, wind-sheltered climate
and dependable water supply.  [Continue Reading][39]

## Featured Mining Town: Ironton, Colorado

[[Featured Mining Town: Ironton, Colorado]][40]

Ironton, Colorado was an important transportation hub and mining camp in southwest Colorado's Red
Mountain district. The town had its best years before 1893, but continued to be a viable settlement
until the 1920s.  [Continue Reading][41]

West, remaining in production for more than eighty years. A company town was established here, and

## Featured Mining Town: Tombstone, Arizona

[[Featured Mining Town: Tombstone, Arizona]][31]

Tombstone, Arizona is best known for the Earp brothers, Doc Holliday, and the gunfight at the OK
Corral. While most people probably know that Tombstone was a mining town, the fact that it was one
of the West's largest silver bonanza's has been overshadowed by the famous events surrounding the
legendary gun battle.  [Continue Reading][32]

## Featured Mining Town: Anyox, British Columbia

[[Featured Mining Town: Anyox, British Columbia]][33]

Anyox was a remote company town operated by the Granby Consolidated Mining, Smelting and Power
Company, which produced primarily copper, with lesser quantities of silver and gold, from 1914 to
1935. Situated roughly 600 miles (1,000 km) north of Vancouver and accessible only by sea, the
construction of a large industrial complex and a community of approximately 2,500 residents
represented a significant logistical and engineering achievement.  [Continue Reading][34]

Boulder, Colorado. During his time there, the mining industry in Boulder County was thriving, and he
documented much of it in photographs throughout the 1890s and the first decade of the twentieth
century.  [Continue Reading][35]

1890s. The mine had its most productive years between 1891 and 1896.  [Continue Reading][37]

[[Featured Mining Town: Shermantown, Nevada]][38]

Shermantown was one of the first three settlements founded in 1868 during the White Pine silver
rush. Established as a milling center for the Treasure Hill mines, its site was chosen not only for

and dependable water supply.  [Continue Reading][39]

Ironton, Colorado was an important transportation hub and mining camp in southwest Colorado's Red
Mountain district. The town had its best years before 1893, but continued to be a viable settlement
until the 1920s.  [Continue Reading][41]

# Welcome to Western Mining History

Mining Regions of the Western United States

The image above illustrates the incredible scale of the mining regions of the western United States.
Yellow dots are gold mines, black dots are non-gold mines. Map icons show the distribution of
historic mining towns. An interactive version of this map is available [here][23].

## The Black Oak Mine

The Black Oak Mine, located near Soulsbyville, California, was a gold producer that operated
intermittently from 1878 through the 1920s. These exclusive photographs were provided by a
descendant of the mine's superintendent.  [Continue Reading][24]

## Featured Mining Town: Pioneer, Montana

[[Featured Mining Town: Pioneer, Montana]][25]

Pioneer grew out of mining activity in the Pioneer District, the site of Montana's first documented
gold discovery. Gold was discovered here in 1852, but the deposits were initially considered too
low-grade to trigger a major rush. Additional discoveries prior to 1866 renewed interest in the
district, although many prospectors were soon lured away by richer strikes elsewhere in western
Montana.  [Continue Reading][26]

## Featured Mining Town: Hamilton, Nevada

[[Featured Mining Town: Hamilton, Nevada]][27]

Established during the White Pine silver rush of 1868, Hamilton became the county seat and
commercial center of the White Pine district. Although the boom was short-lived, Hamilton continued
to serve the region for more than half a century.  [Continue Reading][28]
